transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brought you in today?

Um, hi. I guess... I'm just having some trouble at work. I keep starting things like the sanitation steps, or... the batch logs and end-of-line paperwork. But I somehow always leave out the last parts. Even when I know my job depends on finishing them correctly, I just... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Um, no... not really. I don't think so.
Do you find yourself having repeated unwanted thoughts that are hard to control?
No... I don't really have anything like that. Just... normal thoughts, I guess.
